title: Kayak Rigging & Demo Days
seo_title: Free Kayak Demo Rides & Rigging | Ottawa, IL
seo_description: Try Hobie Mirage Drive and Old Town kayaks free at Heritage Harbor near Ottawa, IL. Book a demo ride and get kayak rigging help from Quest Watersports.
body_html:
Find your perfect kayak with a free demo ride

Ever wondered what it feels like to pedal across the water with the patented Hobie Mirage Drive or Old Town PDL Drive? Or been curious about the Minn Kota powered Old Town Sportsman kayaks? At Quest Watersports, you can experience these for FREE.

Take a demo ride for a hands-on journey with a wide array of Hobie and Old Town models. Enjoy the serenity of Heritage Harbor, a 32-acre marina just 1.5 miles from the Quest showroom.

Why take a demo ride?

  • Test various Hobie and Old Town models at no cost
  • Experience the pedal and paddle sensation in picturesque Heritage Harbor
  • Receive expert guidance to help you select the perfect kayak
  • Easily book your test ride over the phone or through our website

Whether you are a beginner keen to explore or a seasoned enthusiast eager to upgrade, we will help you choose the right kayak and schedule a test ride at a time that fits your plans.

Call us at (815) 433-2200 or book your demo online.

Kayak rigging

Need help getting your kayak set up for fishing, photography or touring? Our team can help outfit your kayak with rod holders, fish finders, anchor trolleys, carts and more. Shop kayak parts and accessories, or call 815.433.2200 or email us to talk through your setup.

Shop kayaks

  • Hobie kayaks
  • Old Town kayaks
  • Kayak fishing guide
  • Kayak and paddleboard rentals

faqs.q: Does it cost anything to demo a kayak?
faqs.a: No. Demo rides on Hobie and Old Town models at Heritage Harbor are free.
